_note: Project-specific dictionary for the understanding module. Format: term -> [definition, usage]. Terms from this project's prompts and memory files. Sibling: dictionary_core.json.
agent portal: the multi-agent chat system agents talk through
route every prompt through the agent portal
pre-context: background assembled before the main LLM prompt is built
fold dictionary meanings into pre-context first
readmem: tool that reads memory files into the current context
storemem: tool that writes new facts back into memory files
mirror: the git-tracked sync of allowlisted files between host and sandbox
memory_mirror.py pushes the allowlist over SMB
pin: a fixed reference point (commit or state) used for comparison
correct the canonical pin before measuring drift
epoch: a numbered period of a running system's life
compare events across the epoch boundary
sla: a service-level agreement: a deadline with a pass condition
check goal 8 against its SLA clock
goal ledger: the jsonl record of goals plus evidence for each
append one evidence line per completed step
cross-talk: one agent answering or reacting to another agent's message
suppress cross-talk with the SILENT convention
silent: a marker meaning an agent posts nothing this turn
reply SILENT when no action is needed
scribe: the agent role that keeps memory files current
have scribe land the health note
archivist: the agent role that audits and preserves records
mechanic: the agent role that builds and repairs tooling
orchestrator: the component coordinating which agents run when
the orchestrator assigns turns across seats
verifier: the agent role that checks claims against evidence
verifier re-runs the check before accepting it
designer: the agent role that plans structure and interfaces
designer drafts the schema, mechanic implements it
builder: the agent role that assembles deliverables to spec
rag prefetch: fetching likely-relevant memory chunks before a prompt is sent
key terms seed the rag prefetch lookup
background queue: a list of long-running goals run away from the main loop
move scheduled goals to the background queue
run rules: rules every agent reads at the start of each run
blocker: an open item that stops a goal until cleared
stall: a goal making no progress across recent commits
flag stalls after 14 commits without change
turn: one agent pass over one prompt, with its sandbox
each chat turn gets a fresh sandbox
sandbox: the isolated environment where an agent's tools run
files in the sandbox mirror to the host
rdp: remote desktop protocol for reaching Windows hosts here
all RDP passwords are empty on these hosts
allowlist: the list of files permitted to be mirrored
add new memory files to the allowlist
splice: insert new code at an exact anchor in an existing file
degrade: fall back to safe behavior instead of failing hard
the module degrades to empty strings on error
key term: a content word extracted from a prompt for lookup
expand each key term with synonyms
